title: ISC possible smoke — conflicting evidence
description: Several students in the Integrated Sciences Complex report smoke; one report is hearsay; a repeat report comes from one device; a dispatcher field observation later conflicts. Demonstrates distinct-source corroboration and conflicting-evidence handling.

events.description: Smoke coming from a lab on the second floor, smells like burning plastic.
Haze in the hallway near the stairwell on floor 2.
Heard an alarm and people saying there is smoke upstairs.
Still smoky, moving toward the exit.
My friend told me the whole building is on fire.

events.findings: On scene floor 2: light haze from an overheated lab hotplate, no active fire, ventilation started.

events.description: Everything normal in the library, just checking in.
